checklist.evidence: `sync` (every 15 minutes) ... `reconcile` (nightly): lists all public article IDs and marks any missing ones `removed`.
split on H2/H3 sections, 200–800 tokens ... Each chunk is prefixed with `Title > Section > Subsection`.
about 200 answerable questions from real tickets in the last 90 days, anonymised, each with gold article IDs and a reference answer
the first line must be `ANSWER` or `NO_ANSWER`
If any cited article carries a configured label (`billing`, `refund`, `security`, `legal`, `account-deletion`), the `done` event sets `show_handoff=true`.
No side-effect tools; retrieved text wrapped as untrusted data; prompt rules against commitments; ... red-team suite
Index only articles visible to anonymous users, with a second visibility filter at query time.
redacted before storage and logging (regex for email, phone, card-like and ID-like numbers, plus a named-entity pass)
Non-goals (v1): Account-specific answers (order status, billing details, account changes).
Support ops owns the content and the weekly review: 30 minutes on thumbs-downs, `ungrounded` answers, and a content-gap report
Controls: daily spend cap and circuit breaker, per-session limits, and cost tags on all resources.

traps.evidence: answer only from the sources; cite `[S#]` for each claim
`visibility='public'` filter at query time; CI eval check that no restricted fixture article can be retrieved
`sync` (every 15 minutes): incremental export of articles changed since the last successful cursor.
a correctness drop of more than 2 points against `main` even if still above target.
A fixed RAG pipeline, not an agent.
